description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, which displays detailed content information for an Android TV application. It manages UI setup, content data population, user interactions, focus animations, and network request handling for play action. The class uses layout resources, intent extras, and external API calls to function within an app focused on TV content presentation.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed information about TV content, with focusable action buttons and network-based playback initiation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, populates content, and sets up focusable buttons.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets current date and time in designated TextViews.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Populates UI with content metadata from intent extras.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Configures focus and click behavior for action buttons.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates focus gain/loss state for action buttons.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Handles action button press with animations and specific functions.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key events to navigate focus and trigger button actions via D-pad.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Performs network request to get media URL and launches player.

methods.name: extractUrlFromResponse
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract media URL.

methods.name: isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Validates that a URL string is an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to generate Intent with content metadata extras.
